summary: Screened 20 base records for Retail / Phoenix / ≤8 mi / 19,500–43,500 sf / closed / single-asset / fee-simple / stabilized / unrelated-party / positive USD consideration within 2025-09-01 through 2026-08-31. Executed amendment U-R9866-1 (effective 2026-08-20) was applied to entity BIRCH-SAL-60411; U-R9548-2 was ignored (effective date after the 2026-08-31 cutoff) and U-R4440-3 was ignored (unsigned draft). Eight records were eligible before deduplication; R5005 was dropped as a duplicate of entity BIRCH-SAL-58018 (kept canonical recorded-deed record R1958), leaving seven unique-entity qualifying comps. The top five, ranked by distance ascending then most recent closing date, are R1958, R9866, R9548, R4440, and R1583 — a tight cluster at ~$400/sf with R9866 at $432.56/sf reflecting the executed-amendment revision.
limitations: R7511 has null consideration; treated as unknown (not zero) per the packet rule and excluded.
R5005 and R1958 share entity BIRCH-SAL-58018; R1958 retained as canonical (recorded_deed_and_closing_statement) and R5005 (second_source_same_underlying_record) dropped as duplicate.
U-R9548-2 is an executed amendment but its effective_date (2026-09-10) is after the 2026-08-31 cutoff, so it was not applied per the later-dated-evidence rule.
U-R4440-3 is an unsigned draft and was not applied.
R2037 property_size is expressed in acres, which does not satisfy the required 'sf' unit; excluded rather than converted, per the 'correct size unit' rule.
Distance, size, status, scope, interest, condition, and party-relationship attributes are taken as reported in the packet with no independent verification.
No SPV-to-parent mappings were present in the packet; the SPV rule was therefore not invoked.
